decision_rule: Handoff succeeds iff rigid-from-checkpoint best-of-16 <= (C02a harden best on star5 n=9) + 1e-3 AND rigid-from-random best-of-16 > (C02a harden best) + 0.01. Same interpretation as C02b-ltri.
extraction: After C02a closes, run: node scripts/extract_checkpoints.js C02a-baselines-replication star5-in-squ 9 > campaigns/C02b-handoff-star5/checkpoints.json ; then wrap as {"rigid": <that array>}. Rule fixed before any C02a run.
hypothesis: On star5-in-squ n=9, where harden beat rigid by 0.10 in C01, rigid search started from harden's tau~0.5 checkpoint reaches harden's basin while rigid from random starts does not. Mechanism test, not efficiency test.
question: Does rigid search reach harden's star5 n=9 basin when started from a mid-morph checkpoint?
title: Checkpoint handoff: star5 n=9
